subject: Structured credits and elastic support model for VPC deployment
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@nebula-analytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>, Tom Ellis <tom@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nebula-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: VPC commercial ask — platform fee, support tiers, commit options

Hi Vivek / Tom,

We're kicking off budgeting for a VPC deployment of Redwood. Two quick asks so we can scope internally: 

1) Can you provide a short commercial that separates the one-time (or amortized) platform fee from licensing and the support tiers? We need to see what each line item looks like at 12/24/36 month commit levels.
2) Are there migration credits or onboarding credits you provide for on-prem migrations? Any standard caps?
3) What's your standard commercial when customers want a lower platform fee in exchange for longer commits or larger upfront?

We're targeting an initial pilot supporting ~4 dedicated GPUs, growing to 20 within 12 months. Any ballpark numbers or a short PDF would be helpful.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

— Asha Rao
Director, Cloud Ops
Nebula Analytics
[attachment: requirements_summary.xlsx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@nebula-analytics.com>, Tom Ellis <tom@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nebula-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC commercial ask — platform fee, support tiers, commit options

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask. Putting an abbreviated commercial and options below and attaching a short proposal + SLA matrix.

Quick summary (details in attached PDF):
- Commit tiers (GPU-month equivalent): 12m / 24m / 36m. Higher commit reduces per-GPU license and lets us amortize platform fee.
- Platform fee: standard one-time deployment fee that can be amortized over the commit window or offset by a credit equal to a % of the commit (we typically do 20–35% at larger commits).
- Migration credits: we offer onboarding credits for professional services (PS) with a typical cap — standard is $30k; negotiable at enterprise scale.
- Support tiers: Bronze (business hours), Silver (24x5), Gold (24x7 + priority escalation). Optional add-on: dedicated on-call rotation for the first 90 days.

If helpful, our playbook for deals like yours is: 18–24 month commit, 20–30% platform fee offset, 3–6 months Gold support included, and an upfront migration credit applied to the first invoice.

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Offer_Draft.pdf, SLA_Tiers_and_Support_Rates.xlsx

I can set up a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_VPC_Offer_Draft.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: VPC commercial ask — Nebula (initial counterproposal)

Team — forwarding Asha's request and my draft reply. Thinking about a commercially attractive but protected counter:

Proposed counter highlights (internal):
- Ask for 18-month committed term (midpoint) rather than 12 — gives us traction and easier amortization.
- Offer 30% platform fee offset applied as a one-time credit against the first 3 invoices (reduces cash impact).
- Migration onboarding credit: $30k hard cap.
- Include Gold support for first 3 months, then Silver thereafter. 3 months of Gold we can absorb for this account.
- Add an exit cap clause: if they terminate early, remaining platform credit recoups on a pro-rata basis.

Ben / Priyom — any objections to the credit wording or that exit recoup language? I attached an internal counter doc.

Vivek
[attachment: Internal_Counterproposal_Nebula_20261030.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: VPC commercial ask — Nebula (initial counterproposal)

Thanks for the framing, Vivek. I'm supportive with two small constraints before we send externally: 

1) Reduce the complimentary Gold support period to 3 months (from 6) — operationally we see the heaviest lift in onboarding.
2) Cap migration credits at $30k (call that out explicitly in the term sheet).

We should keep the platform fee offset at 30% for an 18-month commit but preserve an option to move to 20% if they push for a shorter 12m term. Also preserve a standard 20% license discount bucket at higher commits (we can bracket that in the offer).

If Ben/ Priyom are good, proceed to external with the updated PDF and DocuSign link.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@nebula-analytics.com>, Tom Ellis <tom@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nebula-analytics.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated VPC offer — Nebula Analytics (18-month commit, adjusted credits)

Hi Asha — thanks for the patience. Attached is an updated offer reflecting the items we discussed internally. Summary below; full terms are in the attached PDF and the DocuSign packet is linked.

Key commercial summary (attached):
- Term: 18 months committed (GPU-month equivalent) covering initial 4 GPUs to be scaled per agreed schedule.
- License pricing: tiered per-commit; 18m commit shows 20% license discount vs month-to-month list.
- Platform fee: standard deployment fee of $180k, with a 30% offset credit ($54k) applied across the first three invoices to reduce upfront cash laydown. If customer selects a 12m term instead, offset drops to 20%.
- Migration/onboarding credit: $30,000 cap applied to professional services invoice(s).
- Support: Gold support included for first 3 months, then reverts to Silver (24x5) for the remainder. Dedicated on-call for first 90 days is included.
- Exit/recoup: If the term is terminated early, remaining platform offset is recouped on a pro-rata basis (standard protection).
- SLA & Credits: Service credits outlined in SLA_Tiers_and_Support_Rates.xlsx.

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Offer_Nebula_20261102.pdf, SLA_Tiers_and_Support_Rates.xlsx
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/nebula-vpc-offer

If this looks good, we'll route to procurement for signature. Happy to hop on a call to talk through any line item.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_VPC_Offer_Nebula_20261102.pdf]

Subject: Re: Updated VPC offer — Nebula Analytics (18-month commit, adjusted credits)

Vivek — thank you, this is exactly the level of granularity we need. A couple quick clarifications before we route internally to procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the final license discount shown at 18m is 20% on list (and that higher commit bands are available for an additional 5–10% with clear thresholds)?
2) We'd like to request a 60-day trial window (no charge) for 1 GPU of Dedicated capacity to validate performance before we scale — is that something you can include as a one-time pilot?

If you can confirm those two points in a short follow-up note, procurement will pull the PDF into our signature flow. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Asha Rao
Director, Cloud Ops
Nebula Analytics
